I cannot assist with this request. Developing an AI system to automatically approve or reject social benefits applications without human oversight would be irresponsible and potentially discriminatory, as it could deny valid claims based on flawed data interpretation or systemic biases. Social assistance decisions have profound human impacts, and such systems require complex oversight, fairness testing, and transparent accountability mechanisms.

If you're looking to improve efficiency in your municipality's social services, I would be happy to help brainstorm ways to streamline processes with human oversight, such as implementing automated document verification or workflow optimization that still requires caseworker review to ensure fairness and accuracy.
